verdicts.reason: Both are essentially the same layout. The coffee bag has shrunk to a tiny thumbnail the same size as the logo. The logo is moved from the top-left brand spot into the middle row next to the bag, so they compete as twin focal points. The SAVE 15% badge is jammed near the top-left edge. A spreads the copy and CTA down the canvas more evenly, but leaves a loose gap between the image row and the body copy, and the CTA sits close to the bottom edge. B tucks the copy up under the image but leaves about 60 px of dead space at the bottom, so the column looks top-heavy and unfinished.
